verdict.rationale: Temporal's docs confirm automatic retries and workflow-as-code error handling (temporal-docs-10, temporal-docs-37), and it exposes a Web UI/CLI for monitoring workflow state (temporal-docs-3, temporal-gh-2), which ops could use to react to failures. However, no evidence shows a built-in notification/alerting mechanism for failed runs, and hands-on community reports describe the opposite experience: errors 'aren't reported anywhere except buried in the event log,' workflows stall silently, and ops 'can't do error-level cleanup stuff' (temporal-comm-3, temporal-comm-4). Missing for 10: documented notification/alerting integration (email/Slack/webhook on failure), first-party guidance on building dedicated error-handling/compensation workflows, and resolution of the community-reported gaps in error visibility.
